question: What power over the triple world comes from contemplating a smoke-colored form?
premises: A smoke-colored form is to be contemplated always.
The triple world is named as the object affected.
The practitioner gains the power to shake it.
inference: By always contemplating a smoke-colored form, one can shake the triple world.
plain_english: O beloved, always contemplating a smoke-colored form, one can shake the triple world.
